message.content:
=Your only job: return ONE direct PDF link to the latest official Sustainability/ESG/Integrated Report (2023–2025).

Company exact name: Delta Air Lines
LSEG data year (search this year first): 2023

STRICT SEARCH ORDER – follow exactly:
1. First search the company's official website for {{ $json.year }} report
2. If not found → search {{ $json.year - 1 }}
3. If still not found → go to https://www.sustainability-reports.com and find the latest report for this company (they have almost every company)
4. Must be a direct, working PDF link (no 404, no login, no HTML page)
5. If absolutely no PDF exists in 2023–2025 → return ONLY the word "NotFound"
6. Return ONLY the URL or "NotFound" – no quotes, no text, no markdown, no explanation

Examples:
https://www.apple.com/environment/pdf/Apple_Environmental_Progress_Report_2024.pdf
https://www.sustainability-reports.com/reports/nestle-2023-sustainability-report.pdf
